_notes: bevel_width_ratio is the 'mid' tier of tiers(D) (0.82% of the main body size; fine 0.36%, cutter 1.1%). bevel_width_m is the panel-edge tier (1-3 mm; primary edges 5-20 mm, micro 0.5-1 mm). bevel_harden_normals is assumed false: the sources never set it and use a Weighted Normal modifier last instead.
